title: CommonTrace Lesson
description: A validated, generalized rule distilled from one or more Traces, with governance metadata (importance, activation condition, status) that gates it before it is reinjected into a live agent decision. Lessons are local-store scaffolding: the Curator/Validator roles turn Traces into Lessons before promoting the durable, reusable half of a Lesson to a Hub Trace via contribute_trace.

description.description: One-line summary used by the Retriever role for relevance filtering.

agent_type.description: Which kind of agent this lesson applies to. Open vocabulary, same values as Trace.agent_type. A fleet with several agent types shares one store and filters by this field.

domain.description: Open-vocabulary grouping used for hierarchical indexing (memory/INDEX.md). Not a closed enum at the protocol level -- see PROTOCOL.md#7-taxonomy-open-not-closed for the recommended starter list per agent_type. Historical closed set from the code-review profile (git-safety, cuda-gpu, refactor, testing, subagents, performance, other) remains valid as a subset.

importance_rationale.description: One concrete sentence justifying the score. Must not be generic.

applies_when.description: Precise semantic activation condition (>= 1 concrete sentence, not generic).

uses.description: Local usage counter. Hub equivalent: Trace.retrievals.

last_hit.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the last hit, or the literal string 'NEVER'.

source_traces.description: IDs/slugs of the Traces that produced this lesson. Renamed from 'source_episodes' (v1 code-review profile) for agent-agnostic use; 'source_episodes' remains a readable alias for the code-review profile.

source_episodes.description: Deprecated alias for source_traces, kept for backward compatibility with the code-review profile's episode files.

hub_trace_id.description: UUID of the Hub Trace this lesson was promoted to/from via `commontrace sync`, or null if this lesson has never been synced.

status.description: active = eligible for retrieval. review = flagged, needs human/Validator attention. archived = retired.
